method: 3rd-order Iyer-Will WKB; exact RW potential; Fornberg tortoise derivatives

sensitivity_demo.delta_V: f(r) / r^6  (representative short-range / dim-8 deformation shape)
sensitivity_demo.note: operator->QNM machinery: a potential deformation maps to a finite ringdown (omega_R, omega_I) shift. Plugging the physical R4 quartic delta_V here yields the engine's own operator->QNM sensitivity.

capability: first-principles QNM frequencies from any perturbation potential; the in-house black-hole-spectroscopy tool the R4 ringdown route needs to compute operator->QNM sensitivities without a published map (cf v2.209).
references: Berti, Cardoso, Will, PRD 73 (2006) 064030 (tabulated omega values)
